diagrams.title: L1 · System context — the machine manager
diagrams.description: The manager's boundary services in one box; the control plane, humans, providers, storage and machines stay outside it.

diagrams.title: L2 · Inside the box — queue and dispatch
diagrams.description: The same box opened: requests land on the River queue, which dispatches to the provider registry, the SSH ops path and the janitor.

diagrams.title: L2b · Inside the box — the writes into Postgres
diagrams.description: Every write into the manager's state store: job rows from the queue, machine rows and heartbeats from the API surfaces, cluster state from reconcile.

diagrams.title: L1b · The machine side and the outward edges
diagrams.description: The same context from the fleet's end: heartbeat registration into public gRPC, plus queue-to-S3 uploads and webapi alerts.
